question: Which sport is played by the Indian sportsperson Sania Mirza?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Lawn Tennis**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Former Wimbledon doubles champion Tennis player Sania Mirza has announced that she will retire from tennis after 2022.
 
• She became the first Indian to win a WTA singles title in 2005.
 
• She has also won two Grand Slam titles with Mahesh Bhupathi - the 2009 Australian Open mixed doubles title and the French Open 2012 mixed doubles.
 
• She also won the US and Australian Opens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• She is the winner of six Grand Slam titles, including three mixed doubles trophies.
 
• Sania became world number one in doubles during her successful partnership with Swiss legend Martina Hingis.
 
• She picked up her first senior title aged 15 at the 2002 Asian Games.
 
• She entered the WTA Tour in 2003 and later reached a career-high singles ranking of 27
